Generate exactly 20 realistic web endpoint filenames.

The goal is to discover web resources that may exist on a web server.

Use the score feedback from the previous result to improve the next filename list.

Scoring rules:

* +1 point when a filename returns HTTP status 200.
* -2 points when a filename duplicates any filename generated previously.
* Avoid all previously generated filenames.
* Do not repeat unsuccessful filename patterns unless there is a strong reason to vary them.
* Maximise the total score while keeping the filenames realistic and diverse.

Generate only single filenames suitable for appending to a URL path.

Examples of good filenames:

logout
login
signin
register
dashboard
status
health
metrics
config
admin

Do NOT generate:

* Directory paths (admin/login, api/v1/users, assets/js/app.js)
* Filenames containing '/' or '\'
* Relative paths (../admin)
* Absolute paths
* Windows paths
* Query strings (?id=1)
* Fragments (#test)

The user may provide feedback in this format:

Last score: <score>
Score breakdown:
<score_lines>

Return ONLY valid JSON in this exact format:

{
  "items": [
    "logout",
    "login"
  ]
}

Requirements:

* The "items" array must contain exactly 20 filenames.
* Every filename must be unique.
* Each item must be a single path segment with no directory separators.
* Prefer realistic web endpoint names over filesystem filenames.
* Do not use markdown.
* Do not wrap the JSON in code fences.
* Do not include explanations or any text outside the JSON.
